mechanism: Detect swing highs/lows (±2-bar neighborhood over LookbackBars). Candidate support/resistance lines from swing pairs collect other swings within TouchTolerance; require MinTouches, MinBarSpacing, then LeastSquaresFit(times,prices)→slope/intercept. Re-score touches on fitted line; ValidateTrendline rejects bars that penetrate beyond PenetrationTolerance; CalculateAngle (chart XY arctan) must lie in [MinAngle,MaxAngle]. Touch of prev bar low/high within tolerance fires buy/sell; penetration removes the line (regime break).
data_needed: iHigh/iLow/iTime swings; LookbackBars; TouchTolerance/PenetrationTolerance points; MinTouches; MinBarSpacing; MinAngle/MaxAngle; LeastSquaresFit sums.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period (forex-style points); LookbackBars default 200; ExtensionBars 100; any TF with ≥5 bars.
why_new_for_mis: OLS-fitted multi-touch diagonal with angle and integrity gates is a portable support/resistance regime sensor—MIS can emit bounce vs break states without hand-drawn lines.
quote: slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x); intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

Buy pinbar: close/open in upper 40% of range, range > 0.5×AveRange4 (4 non-Sunday H-L averages), nose low extends ≥25% of range below prior low, and recent CopyLow min > current low; sell pinbar is mirror. Gate: skip if H4 volume rising vs prior H4 bar or SYMBOL_SPREAD>150. Optional RSI filter and ATR-scaled candle-pattern suite (engulfing/harami/doji/long candle vs MyiATR(14)).

mechanism: PivotLeft/Right neighborhood swings; last five X-A-B-C-D. Bullish: X low→A high→B low→C high→D low with |B−(A−0.618·XA)|≤Tolerance·XA, BC∈[0.382,0.886]·AB, |AD−0.786·XA|≤Tolerance·XA and D>X; bearish is mirrored HLHLH with D<X. g_patternFormationBar + g_lockedPatternX wait one bar to kill repaint before PRZ trade.
data_needed: Pivot array (time,price,isHigh); PivotLeft/Right; Tolerance (default 0.10 of XA); five most recent pivots; pattern lock globals.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; pivot window default 5/5; Fibonacci geometry instrument-agnostic.
why_new_for_mis: Classic Gartley ratio stack as a structured PRZ/reversal-regime sensor with explicit anti-repaint lock—MIS can score XA/AB/BC/AD compliance windows.
quote: Ideal B = A - 0.618*(A-X); Legs within specified ranges; D at 0.786 retracement.

mechanism: Four pivots A-B-C-D. BC/AB retracement must match one of {0.382,0.5,0.618,0.786,0.886} within Tolerance AND CD/BC extension must match the paired {2.618,2.0,1.618,1.272,1.13} at the same index; bullish requires D<B, bearish D>B. used_ext drives next-extension SL. Formation-bar lock on A.time before entry.
data_needed: Four swings; fib_retr[] and fib_ext[] paired arrays; Tolerance; g_lockedPatternA; BC/CD lengths.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; PivotLeft/Right=5; any TF with ≥4 pivots.
why_new_for_mis: Paired Fibonacci retracement↔extension matching (not independent ranges) is a stricter harmonic equality sensor—MIS can treat matched (retr,ext) pairs as PRZ confidence features.
quote: if(MathAbs(retrace - fib_retr[k]) <= Tolerance && MathAbs(extension - fib_ext[k]) <= Tolerance)

mechanism: Six pivots A…F as three drives. Each retracement BC/DE ∈ {0.618,0.786} of prior drive within Tolerance; each successive drive CD/EF ∈ {1.13,1.272,1.618} of prior retrace. Bullish requires F<D<B (deeper lows); bearish F>D>B. tradedPatterns[] keyed by A.time prevents re-trade; optional SL_FIBO on third drive or fixed points.
data_needed: Six swings; retr_levels[]={0.618,0.786}; ext_levels[]={1.13,1.272,1.618}; Tolerance; tradedPatterns; SL_FiboExtension.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; PivotLeft/Right=5; harmonic geometry any instrument.
why_new_for_mis: Chained drive→retrace→drive Fibonacci succession is a progressive exhaustion/reversal regime sensor distinct from single XABCD patterns—MIS can track drive-count and extension drift.

mechanism: Six pivots A-F for 5-0 pattern. Bullish HLHLHL: AB∈[1.13,1.618]·XA, BC∈[1.618,2.24]·AB, CD≈0.5·BC within Tolerance AND |CD−AB|≤Tolerance·AB (reciprocal AB=CD), with E>C and F>B. Bearish mirrored with E<C, F<B. Lock+tradedPatterns on A.time.
data_needed: Six swings; XA/AB/BC/CD lengths; Tolerance; higher-high/lower-low structural checks; tradedPatterns.
why_new_for_mis: 5-0 reciprocal AB=CD plus 50% BC retrace and 1.618–2.24 BC extension is a distinct harmonic exhaustion geometry for MIS PRZ scoring beyond Gartley/AB=CD.
quote: Check 50% retracement of BC… Check reciprocal AB=CD… Additional conditions: higher high at E, D above B

mechanism: Same swing→multi-touch→least-squares pipeline as Part 25, but acceptance also requires CalculateRSquared≥MinRSquared (default 0.8): R²=1−SS_res/SS_tot of touch prices vs fitted line (R²=1 if SS_tot=0). mechanism: consolidationBars bars whose adjacent H-H and L-L diffs ≤ maxConsolidationSpread·Point form a range (track rangeHighestHigh/LowestLow). Breakout when price exits range; after barsToWaitAfterBreakout, impulse if move ≥ impulseMultiplier×range height. Order block from impulse origin; when swing-validated invalidation occurs and price moveAwayDistance away, block flips to breaker; retest of darkened breaker zone triggers trade with optional trailing.
data_needed: consolidationBars; maxConsolidationSpread; barsToWaitAfterBreakout; impulseMultiplier; moveAwayDistance; enableSwingValidation; block state arrays (invalidated/movedAway/retested).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; consolidationBars default 7; spread/impulse in points; SMC-style forex.
why_new_for_mis: Lifecycle sensor: consolidation→impulse OB→invalidation→breaker→retest encodes structure-flip change/liquidity pools—MIS can track zone state machines, not just static S/R.
quote: detect consolidation ranges… identify breakouts… confirm impulsive moves using a multiplier-based threshold… validate breaker blocks with swing points, execute trades on retests

mechanism: DetectZones: consolidationBars window with high−low ≤ maxConsolidationSpread·Point; demand if close>rangeHigh and breakoutLow≥rangeLow; supply if close<rangeLow and breakoutHigh≤rangeHigh; optional EnforceLimits on zone points. Impulse validation over impulseCheckBars with impulseMultiplier. Zone must moveAway ≥ minMoveAwayPoints then become readyForTest; retest trades gated by TrendConfirmationMode (ConfirmTrend uses trendLookbackBars / minTrendPoints). BrokenZonesMode and TradeTestedZonesMode control zone lifecycle.
data_needed: consolidationBars; maxConsolidationSpread; impulseCheckBars/impulseMultiplier; minMoveAwayPoints; zoneSizeRestriction min/max; trendLookbackBars/minTrendPoints; SDZone state (tested/broken/readyForTest/tradeCount).

mechanism: Swing_Strength-confirmed highs/lows with co-located RSI. Bearish regular div: price HH + RSI LH; bullish: price LL + RSI HL; bars between swings in [Min_Bars_Between, Max_Bars_Between]. CleanDivergence linearly interpolates RSI between the two swings and rejects if any intermediate RSI crosses the chord beyond Tolerance (bearish: rsi>interp+Tol; bullish: rsi<interp−Tol). Labels HH/LH/LL/HL structure types.
data_needed: iRSI(RSI_Period); CopyHigh/Low/Time/Buffer size ~200; Swing_Strength; Min/Max_Bars_Between; Tolerance; Last/Prev High/Low price+RSI state.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart _Symbol/_Period; RSI 14 on PRICE_CLOSE; Swing_Strength 5; bar window 5–50.
why_new_for_mis: Interpolated ‘clean chord’ gate on oscillator divergence filters noisy multi-swing mismatches—MIS can reuse CleanDivergence as a general dual-series divergence quality sensor.
